**Build is green again.**

The real problem was the error at the end, not the warnings. Two bugs, both from the bump:

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`. The bump renamed that key to `retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw when the flag was unset. Unset now counts as off, like before.

The 8 warnings still print. They all name files this folder does not have.
